device_protocol: single Kaggle T4 / model on GPU0

tasks.single: one target fact at varying document depth
tasks.hard_multi: three target facts plus same-format distractor records
tasks.reason: four-hop variable tracking plus distractor chain

blocksal.budget_semantics: whole-block eviction; actual retained tokens may be up to block_size-1 below nominal budget
blocksal.note: Specialized 035 passkey scripts historically used block_size=8; Phase 02 pins the general full-comparison canonical configuration at 16.

recency_only.selector: first N_SINK tokens plus most recent remaining tokens

random_retention.selector: random middle tokens with sink+recency protection
random_retention.seed_policy: derived deterministically from global seed, task, sample_id, and budget

validation_gate.note: If SnapKV or StreamingLLM fails validation, comparison scores are not produced.

snapkv_adapter_query_parity.method: capture native query tensor entering torch SDPA on MobileMoE first attention layer
snapkv_adapter_query_parity.rationale: does not assume q_norm is exposed as a module; catches functional QK normalization if present

scoring.absolute: exact pass and fact recall over every generated case
scoring.full_context_conditioned: exact pass and fact recall over cases solved by FullContext
scoring.distractor_policy: hard_multi/reason exact pass requires target recovery without forbidden distractor values
scoring.note: No case is deleted from the raw artifact; conditioning is an additional analysis view.

snapkv.reason: MobileMoE native SDPA query parity failed for the current compatibility adapter.
snapkv.interpretation: SnapKV executes and compresses, but is excluded from Phase 02 scoring because representation parity is not faithful enough to support a clean external-baseline claim.
snapkv.future_work: Revisit only in a separate compatibility study; do not block the current MobileMoE benchmark.

streamingllm.reason: Smoke generation on MobileMoE became degenerate/repetitive despite exact cache-length validation.
streamingllm.interpretation: Technical execution alone is insufficient evidence of semantic compatibility, so StreamingLLM is excluded from the N25 scoring run.
streamingllm.future_work: Revisit only in a separate compatibility study.

routing: decode-only raw projected Top-1 transition rate

routing_semantics.raw: non-mutating projected router Top-K from exact decode hidden states and router weights
routing_semantics.stable: counterfactual smoothing only; not executed expert dispatch

metrics_contract.ppl_semantics: PPL is computed over each method's own generated answer tokens from generation logits, not held-out corpus perplexity.
